title: Software stocks are rising, and these 6 are expected to withstand the AI threat
excerpt: Most software companies are expected to show a slowing pace of sales growth over the next two years. Oracle and DigitalOcean are among the exceptions.
content_html:
As investors bail on chip stocks, they are taking a fresh look at software stocks, which have been weighed down by artificial-intelligence concerns.

Among software stocks, Workday WDAY, Autodesk ADSK, Palantir Technologies PLTR and ServiceNow NOW were among the biggest S&P 500 SPX gainers on Monday, logging price increases in the neighborhood of 7% or greater. They helped power the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector exchange-traded fund IGV to a 3.3% gain on a day when the VanEck Semiconductor ETF SMH declined 2.3%.

  • College kids are moving into retirement communities for reasons beyond 'cheap rent'

The rotation continued into Tuesday's session, with Accenture ACN and Workday among the S&P 500's top performers as the chip-sector selloff intensified and investors looked for new places to park funds. The iShares Expanded-Tech Software Sector ETF was up another 1.3% in midday trading.

The top 25 semiconductor and hardware companies account for about $22 trillion in combined market capitalization, Evercore ISI analyst Kirk Materne said in a note to clients on Tuesday, "so even a very small amount of capital flowing from semis to software can move the needle."

Still, it is worth putting the software sector's recent momentum into perspective. The S&P 500's software industry group is down 18% so far this year, reflecting concerns about disruption risk brought about by artificial intelligence. Furthermore, IBM IBM recently highlighted that customers had less budget room for general software offerings because they have had to allocate more money toward hardware and cybersecurity.

Read: Software stocks get a rotation boost as chips and overall tech sell off

Another reason for this year's harsh software-sector declines could be the expectation of slowing sales growth for many companies. For example, Salesforce's CRM revenue increased at a compound annual growth rate of 9.9% from calendar 2022 through 2025, according to FactSet. Based on consensus estimates, the company is expected to increase sales at a lower CAGR of 6.3% from 2026 through 2028.

While investors are wading back into software stocks, many analysts recommend a selective approach, since the threat of AI still clouds the sector.

To that end, MarketWatch sought to identify companies that are projected to show higher sales CAGRs through 2028 than they did in the period from 2022 to 2025.

Among the 24 software companies in the S&P 500 SPX for which FactSet has consensus revenue estimates through 2028, all but three are expected to see slower paces of sales growth from 2026 through 2028 than they did from 2022 through 2025. content_html_zh:
随着投资者纷纷抛售芯片股，他们正在重新审视软件股，这些股一直受到人工智能担忧的拖累。

在软件股中，Workday WDAY、Autodesk ADSK、Palantir Technologies PLTR 和 ServiceNow NOW 是周一 S&P 500 SPX 涨幅最大的股票之一，其价格涨幅接近 7% 或更高。 他们帮助 iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector 交易所交易基金 IGV 上涨 3.3%，而 VanEck Semiconductor ETF SMH 下跌 2.3%。

大多数阅读来自 MarketWatch

  • 随着收益率飙升，债券市场正在揭穿沃什在抗击通胀方面的虚张声势
  • 大学生进入退休社区的原因不仅仅是“租金便宜”

这种轮动一直持续到周二交易时段，随着芯片行业抛售加剧以及投资者寻找新的资金存放地，埃森哲 ACN 和 Workday 跻身标准普尔 500 指数中表现最好的股票之列。 iShares Expanded-Tech Software Sector ETF 在午盘交易中又上涨 1.3%。

Evercore ISI 分析师 Kirk Materne 在周二给客户的一份报告中表示，前 25 家半导体和硬件公司的总市值约为 22 万亿美元，“因此，即使是从半导体流向软件的极少量资本也能起到推动作用。”

尽管如此，还是值得正确看待软件行业近期的势头。 标准普尔 500 指数的软件行业板块今年迄今已下跌 18%，反映出人们对人工智能带来的颠覆风险的担忧。 此外，IBM 最近强调，客户用于通用软件产品的预算空间较小，因为他们必须在硬件和网络安全上分配更多资金。

阅读：随着芯片和整体科技股的抛售，软件股得到轮动提振

今年软件行业严重下滑的另一个原因可能是许多公司销售增长放缓的预期。 例如，根据 FactSet 的数据，从 2022 年到 2025 年，Salesforce 的 CRM 收入以 9.9% 的复合年增长率增长。 根据共识预测，2026 年至 2028 年，该公司的销售额预计将以 6.3% 的较低复合年增长率增长。

尽管投资者重新涉足软件股，但许多分析师建议采取选择性投资方式，因为人工智能的威胁仍然笼罩着该行业。

为此，MarketWatch 试图找出预计到 2028 年销售额复合年增长率将高于 2022 年至 2025 年期间的公司。

FactSet 对标普 500 SPX 指数中的 24 家软件公司到 2028 年的收入预测达成共识，其中除 3 家外，预计 2026 年至 2028 年的销售增长速度将低于 2022 年至 2025 年。 以下是三个例外情况，按市值排序，并根据与传统日历周期不匹配的报告期进行调整：
